intro: status.dliu.com 每 15 分钟以游客身份（不登录、不带 Cookie）检查一次本网站：打开公开页面和网址，再读取 /health，后者报告每项后台功能是否正常。

Every 15 minutes status.dliu.com checks this site as a guest (not signed in, no cookies): it opens the public pages and URLs, then reads /health, which reports whether each behind-the-scenes function is working.

name: 页面
Pages
what: 仪表板和文档页面能打开。
The dashboard and the docs pages open.

name: 公开统计
Public statistics
what: 游客看到的 7、30 和 90 天总计每天更新。
The 7, 30 and 90-day totals guests see are refreshed every day.
down: 游客看到的数字停在旧的一天。
Guests see numbers stuck on an old day.

reads: When stats/7d.json was last written (S3 HeadObject)
fail: 超过 50 小时或读取失败
Older than 50 hours, or the read fails

name: 页面脚本
Page script
what: 各网站加载的页面脚本 /t/s.js 可以下载。
The page script the sites load, /t/s.js, downloads.
down: 各网站不再报告页面停留时间和点击。
The sites stop reporting time on page and clicks.

name: Microsoft 登录
Microsoft sign-in
what: “登录”会转到 Microsoft，未登录时私人数据保持锁定。
Sign in sends you to Microsoft, and private data stays locked without it.
down: 网站主人无法登录查看完整仪表板；游客不受影响。
The owner cannot sign in to see the full dashboard; guests are not affected.

reads: 登录设置（SSM GetParameters，与登录相同的读取，缓存 5 分钟）
The sign-in settings (SSM GetParameters, the same read sign-in does, cached 5 minutes)
fail: The read fails or times out

name: 请求记录
Request logging
what: CloudFront 送来的各网站日志文件被及时整理归档。
The log files CloudFront delivers for every site are filed as they arrive.
down: 新的访问不再被记录，仪表板停在过去。
New visits are no longer recorded, and the dashboard stops moving.

reads: 日志整理函数最近 3 小时的调用次数（CloudWatch GetMetricStatistics，一个指标）
How often the log partitioner ran in the last 3 hours (CloudWatch GetMetricStatistics, one metric)
fail: 一次都没有，或读取失败
Not at all, or the read fails

name: 机器人检查
Bot check
what: 每 6 小时一次的机器人检查按时完成，它使用的托管网络列表每周更新。
The bot check that runs every 6 hours finishes on time, and the hosting network list it uses is refreshed weekly.
down: 机器人会被算作真人，访问人数虚高。
Bots get counted as people, so visitor numbers run high.

reads: 上次运行的状态 bots/status.json（S3 GetObject，一个小文件）和 hosting/asns.json 的修改时间（S3 HeadObject）
The last run's status, bots/status.json (S3 GetObject, one small file), and when hosting/asns.json was last written (S3 HeadObject)
pass: 7 小时内完成，且列表在 8 天内更新
Finished within 7 hours, and the list is under 8 days old
warn: 7–25 小时，或上次运行失败，或列表更旧
7–25 hours, or the last run failed, or the list is older
fail: 超过 25 小时或读取失败
Older than 25 hours, or the read fails

untested: 已登录后的仪表板：每个组件背后的 Athena 查询只对网站主人开放。
The signed-in dashboard: the Athena queries behind every widget are for the owner only.
“立即检查机器人”按钮和 AbuseIPDB 信誉查询（需要登录，且 AbuseIPDB 每天的免费额度有限）。
The Check bots now button and the AbuseIPDB reputation lookups (they need a sign-in, and AbuseIPDB's free allowance is limited).
页面脚本的上报 /t/e：测试上报会被算作一次真实访问。
The page script's reports to /t/e: a test report would count as a real visit.
在 Microsoft 完成登录本身（需要一个获准的账户）。
Completing the sign-in at Microsoft (it needs an assigned account).
每日日志合并和每月城市数据库下载只能间接看到：它们出问题时，公开统计或机器人检查会变旧。
The daily log merge and the monthly city database download are seen only indirectly: when they break, Public statistics or Bot check go stale.
